item.title: 【ŠÂ‹«】 Advancing biodiversity through poverty solutions
item.description: Forest biodiversity is linked, in many cases, to the myriad ecosystem services that support the livelihoods of human populations. Authors here examine the demographic, socioeconomic and institutional variables that impact forest biodiversity across 322 tropical forests.

item.title: 【ŠÂ‹«】 Sea-level-driven land conversion amplified by coastal agriculture
item.description: As sea levels rise, coastal ecosystems and economies are threatened by saltwater intrusion and wetland encroachment. These effects are accelerated by coastal agriculture, highlighting the importance of local management interventions.
